build_roformer_masked_lm: build a RoFormer masked language model for bidirectional token prediction with cross-entropy loss
build_roformer_causal_lm: build a RoFormer causal language model for autoregressive next-token prediction with past key-value caching
build_roformer_sequence_classification: build a RoFormer sequence classification model with a classification head for GLUE tasks and regression support
build_roformer_token_classification: build a RoFormer token classification model for named entity recognition with per-token logits output
